Bottom line: Your leveraged positions are bleeding, and margin is making it worse. Focus on managing these downside risks.
plays: Trim SOXL: It's down 75% and a leveraged ETF. Consider reducing exposure if you can.
Trim SMCI: Down nearly 40%. If it breaks its stop at 37.3, consider cutting losses.
